name: fengshui-report
title_zh: 人宅合盘报告：只讲你住进去后会发生什么
tagline_zh: 看房时中介只讲优点，风水师只说凶吉。这份报告基于你提供的真实数据，告诉你这房子和你八字合不合，住进去后哪些事会顺。
tagline_en: Agents praise the place, fengshui masters talk in vague omens. This report uses your actual data to tell you if.
desc_en: Generate a natural Chinese consumer report about person-house compatibility, with useful conclusions and targeted suggestions grounded in supplied facts.
why_zh: 不是玄学话术，而是基于你给的朝向、楼层、入住人生辰等硬数据，推演五行生克与方位吉凶，结论有推导过程。
why_en: No vague mysticism—it computes Five Elements interactions and directional luck from hard inputs like orientation, floor, and.
limit_zh: 只覆盖阳宅人宅匹配，不涉及流年飞星、择日、阴宅。需提供至少出生年月日和房屋朝向，否则报告只能泛泛而谈。
limit_en: Covers only person-house compatibility, not annual flying stars, date selection, or graves. Requires birth date and house orientation; otherwise.
title_en: Person-House Compatibility Report: What Happens After You.
